name: sambapos-lba
description: SambaPos_LBA — POS web moderno para restaurantes (root package dedicated to Capacitor/Android tooling)

scripts.build:web: echo 'Frontend is static — no build step needed. webDir is frontend/'
scripts.build:android:debug: npm run test:android:config && npm run cap:sync && gradle assembleDebug
scripts.build:android:release: npm run test:android:config && npm run cap:sync && gradle bundleRelease
scripts.pages:smoke: node scripts/build-pages-demo.js && node scripts/serve-pages.js _site /Samba_Pos_V3-Web/ 8080 & sleep 1 && cd backend && PAGES_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8080/Samba_Pos_V3-Web/ npx playwright test -c playwright.pages.config.js
